name: @tps/edge
description: TPS on Cloudflare: the Worker behind BuildFlow's /tps paths (static SPA + API routing) and the bff-tps and worker-tps containers. Outside the pnpm workspace (install with --ignore-workspace).

scripts.deploy:dry: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('../../apps/web/dist',{recursive:true})" && node render.mjs --env dev --account-id 00000000000000000000000000000000 --tag dry-run --out wrangler.dry.json && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c wrangler.dry.json --outdir dist
